text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Three years since starting our challenge 
in the Twinkle Series, on an early 
afternoon marking a major milestone.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"Because she's just an ordinary girl, 
seeing her win gave me so much courage!"

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
"Matikanetannhauser's victory at the Arima 
Kinen gave courage to countless people—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I was watching the news, 
Matikanetannhauser came to visit.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to come visit my hometown 
with me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, my parents and I were just talking 
about having a picnic.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"So, since she said she'd treat us while 
she was at it, I thought you should come 
along too, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Umm, we were supposed to meet around here, 
right...?

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are, Tannhauser~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A couple carrying large stacked bento 
boxes came walking over, waving toward us.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
Sorry I'm late, getting ready took longer 
than expected. Thank you as always for 
taking care of my daughter~.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you said you were bringing someone 
special, so I couldn't help feeling a bit 
restless.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
My husband and I put our hearts into 
cooking these, so please enjoy yourselves 
today.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Even so, I never imagined!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"To think someone so earnest-looking was 
your partner! Way to go, Tannhauser!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
W-We're not lovers, okay?! He's my 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, oh gosh, is that what it means!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All in all, we decided to search for a 
good spot and move there.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Since you were visiting, I thought I'd 
braise some shark fin, but I couldn't get 
the flavor quite right. I'm sorry I only 
have ordinary dishes to offer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stacked bento boxes she laid out 
before me... were of such incredible 
quality, I had no words...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Waaa...! Trainer! This is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hamburg steak and fried shrimp, simmered 
vegetables, sushi rolls, and tamagoyaki 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Every single one is a popular dish from 
our shop~! Thank you, Mom and Dad!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every single dish was exquisite beyond 
imagination... I felt like I understood a 
little better where her high-level 
'ordinary' came from.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Still, really, this child has always 
choked when it matters most.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
When I got picked for the inter-school 
Umamusume relay, I pushed myself way too 
hard in solo practice, wrecked my body, 
and came down with a high fever on the day 
of the race.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
Even when she tried to cook a feast for 
Labor Thanksgiving Day, she made so many 
trial batches that she ran out of pocket 
money.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: D-Don't bring up old stories like that~!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's precisely why the Arima 
Kinen... was so wonderful, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Winning decisively with a massive cheer 
from the entire venue, wouldn't that be 
great...!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Both of them ended up crying. You 
worked so hard, Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Dad, Mom...

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
Thank you too, Trainer. For supporting my 
child all the way to such a grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't possess a dazzling brilliance. 
Even so, to us, she is our special 
treasure...

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her shine brighter than anyone like 
that, and becoming everyone's courage... 
It makes me so, so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: D-Daddy, M-Mommy...!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: Please eat plenty today! *sniff*...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three of them picked at the layered 
food boxes through their tears... It 
became a moment where they truly felt the 
deep love of their parents.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew, I'm stuffed...! That was delicious~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I never imagined she would end up 
crying that much."
choice_data_list: I was sure you were easily moved to tears.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, usually she's quite normal! It's 
not often she gets so overcome with 
emotion reminiscing about the past."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I was so happy! To think the two 
of them were that thrilled for me.”

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you so much, Trainer.
choice_data_list: That's all thanks to your own hard work
That's all thanks to your own hard work.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, I never could've done it alone~. 
Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
She patiently watched over me even when I 
messed up at crucial moments.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Trainer was the one who drew out my most 
precious feelings and helped me realize 
them.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You gave me the strength to move forward. 
So... yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Over these past three years, maybe the 
"protagonist" in my heart was you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Just kiddin'.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And Matikanetannhauser's expression 
turned somewhat solemn.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um. I think I'm still gonna mess up pretty 
often from here on out. Like catching a 
cold right when it matters most.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, I feel like you're the only one for 
me after all, so—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm not much, but from here on out, 
will you continue to walk this path with 
me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehe, I'm so happy...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm counting on you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a slightly shyer expression than 
usual, she gave a small bow.

text_block_list.name: Conductor
text_block_list.text: "Doors closing. Next stop is—..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Aah, I missed my stop!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My days with this "ordinary," hardworking, 
slightly clumsy girl are far from over.
